avis.texte: I have oily sensitive skin with some rosacea and my skin loves this serum. It gives my skin good hydration without making it oily.
This contains niacinimide and it does not disclose it in the bottle. I dont buy any products that have niacinimide because it causes me to break out. They should disclose it on the actual bottle.

avis.titre: I think it works... but.... (you'll want to read).
avis.texte: The bottle feels EMPTY. It's sooo odd. I may switch this for my Elf Thirst drops instead moving forward for price. I like the feeling of it, but the container really feels like there's nothing there..... so it's a little misleading in my opinion. Not to mention, when I got the product, the container bottom wasn't attached - so the actual bottle was half "empty". I had to pop the piece back on. (You could physically see, the bottle was empty with the bottom piece off, which is pretty sad....

I have very dry sensitive skin for starters, but i saw a makeup artist on tiktok use this in her routine to achieve a flawless base, lots of people submitted their photos doing it and they all looked amazing! So i thought I'd try it, ITCHYYY SKINNNN and tingling as soon as i apply it. Additionally, I don't think this has helped with hydration at all, as I still have very apparent dry skin patches. I know no serum is a miracle worker but even my Good Molecules hydrating serum tends to help with them. This hasn't helped with my dryness at all. But aside from that more importantly, this makes my skin tingle and itchy. Not a fan :/

I wanted to like this, but i think its breaking me out. I've noticed now every time i wear it my skin gets red and bumpy. It does make you look glowy which is great. Just doesnt work for everyone. Try at your own risk.
I absolutely love this serum! I use this every evening after my shower. It feels great on my skin!

I recently tried this serum and two other Bubble products expecting they would add much needed moisture to my very dry skin. 2 weeks of daily use and my face has never felt worse; stripped completely of any moisture and feels like sand paper.

As someone with dry skin, this is one of the most plumping, hydrating products I've ever used. That being said, it's also one of the stickiest products I've ever used. It's pleasant being applied to the skin, but it dries down super tacky and the feeling doesn't go away no matter what I layer it with or how much I use. Everyone's skin is different though, and some people may not experience that feeling! I would 100% recommend giving it a try if you're looking for softer, plumper, livelier skin and don't mind the possibility of stickiness.
